symptom: ako/mxcli#981 item 6: `datepart(MONTH, r.RaceDate)` next to `group by datepart(YEAR, r.RaceDate)` passes check AND mxbuild, then the view fails whenever it is read: PostgreSQL 42803, HSQLDB 42574
cause: mxbuild only checks plain columns against the GROUP BY; an expression is passed through to the database
insight: A runtime-only failure has no CE to grep for, so nothing downstream catches it — make it an error. Plain column vs expression is exactly the line between mxbuild's CE0174 (MDL035) and the database's refusal (MDL036)
